label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) alert-TP: The sink response.sendRedirect(url) at line 24 resolves to the value of 'url', which is obtained from request.getSession().getAttribute("partnerCallback"). The mitigation url.startsWith("https://") only validates the protocol scheme, failing to restrict the domain. An attacker influencing the session attribute (or if the attribute is initialized insecurely) can redirect to arbitrary HTTPS hosts (e.g., https://evil.com), constituting an Open Redirect vulnerability.

evidence.note: Session attribute flows directly to sendRedirect without domain validation
